title: Chapter 64
text:
"The border of Hesla?" Gu Hui knocked on the table and said in a low voice, "We need to contact Hesla's military intelligence department before we can decide whether to send troops."

"Then I'll wait for your good news."

Han Xiao nodded and left the meeting room.

Feng Jun was already waiting outside the door. He complained as soon as he saw Han Xiao. "You put me in so much trouble this time. Why didn't you inform me when you encountered the assassin? I was scolded by my superiors because of you."

"You won't be able to help, so why should I inform you?" Han Xiao was surprised.

Feng Jun felt as if he had eaten a pot of cockroaches. He said angrily, "We are close, but if you insult me, I will be angry!"

Han Xiao smiled. "Maybe I should discuss with the director how my location was exposed."

Feng Jun: "Oh, hahahahaha, you bastard, why would I be angry at you?"

"Despicable." Han Xiao rolled his eyes.

With Feng Jun sending him off, Han Xiao left the headquarters and returned to the repair shop.

Han Xiao had the idea of making a face-changing mask a long time ago. With his understanding of the Germinal Organization, he knew that he could not hide his identity forever. Once his location was exposed, he would definitely be punished. The face-changing mask was one of the backup plans he had for himself.

Stardragon would most likely agree to this operation, so he would need to upgrade his combat equipment. The lightweight mechanical arm and retractable knife would not be able to keep up with the enemy's strength. Furthermore, this operation would be outside the country, so Han Xiao felt that he would need a personal vehicle, preferably with the team.

Speaking of the team, Zhang Wei's Battler armor was in urgent need of improvement.

This was a big project.

Han Xiao rubbed his eyebrows and quickly found a pile of blueprints that were most suitable for the current situation. Looks like I'll have to learn a lot this time.

Han Xiao knocked on Old Man Lu's door. Old Man Lu was in the middle of munching on spicy chicken feet with wine. His hands were dripping with grease as he glanced at Han Xiao. "Brat, what are you doing here?"

"I want to borrow a mechanical knowledge book."

Han Xiao turned his head and looked at the bookcase that covered the entire wall.

He thought that Old Man Lu would refuse like the last time, but unexpectedly, Old Man Lu agreed immediately. He pouted at the bookcase and said, "The key is in the drawer. Take whatever you want. Remember to return it to me when you're done."

Han Xiao was shocked. "You actually agreed?"

I don't think we're that close!

Old Man Lu put down the chicken feet and snorted. "Just take it as my thanks."

Thank him? Han Xiao frowned and said uncertainly, "Is this another one of your tricks to promote your granddaughter?"

Old Man Lu's face stiffened. What's so bad about my granddaughter? Why don't you like her?

However, Old Man Lu wasn't thanking Han Xiao for this. Old Man Gao had told him that Han Xiao had left the repair shop to deal with the assassination attempt. He hadn't implicated Lu Qian, and that was why Old Man Lu was thanking him. After this incident, Old Man Lu found Han Xiao much more pleasing to the eye.

"Kid, you're not bad."

Old Man Lu patted Han Xiao's shoulder and walked out with a satisfied smile. He left him in the room to read, showing that he trusted him.

Han Xiao looked at the greasy handprint on his shoulder and the corner of his mouth twitched. "Damn old man."

Han Xiao took out the key and opened the bookcase. Rows of basic knowledge books jumped into view. He took out the seven books he needed and brought them back to his room.

He took a deep breath, adjusted his state of mind, and chose to learn all of them!

[Consume 1 potential point to learn the Energy Branch [Basic Energy Theory]?]

[… Energy Branch [Basic Biochemistry]?]

[… Energy Branch [Basic Optics]?]

"Yes!"

A large amount of knowledge rushed into his mind, and it felt like his brain was about to explode. It took a while for Han Xiao to calm down. He gritted his teeth and continued to pick up the rest of the books.

[… Control Branch [Basic Electromagnetic Theory]?]

[… Control Branch [Basic Mechanical Theory]?]

[… Control Branch [Basic Virtual Electronics]?]

[… Control Branch [Basic Spatial Sensing]?]

Seven basic knowledge books!

That's not all!

[Basic Energy Theory] leveled up to Lv. 3!

[Basic Electromagnetic Theory] leveled up to Lv. 2!

[Basic Virtual Electronics] leveled up to Lv. 2!

[Basic Mechanical Theory] leveled up to Lv. 2!

[Basic Mechanical Engineering] leveled up from Lv. 2 to Lv. 4!

[Basic Weaponry] leveled up to Lv. 3!

[Basic Material Encyclopedia] leveled up to Lv. 3!

[Basic Assembly] leveled up to Lv. 2!

[Advanced Material Synthesis] leveled up to Lv. 2!

His Potential Points were spent faster than water. He originally had 21 Potential Points, but after this round of crazy learning, he had spent 20 Potential Points!

You have learned the skill [Basic Programming].

You have learned the skill [Energy — Electromagnetic Enhancement].

Basic Programming came from [Basic Virtual Electronics Technology]. It was the prerequisite skill for creating all kinds of chips and programs. Like Simple Assembly and Simple Modification, it was a core ability of a Mechanic.

Energy – Electromagnetic Enhancement was an ability that could be unlocked after a Mechanic awakened the Magnetic Attribute and learned the Energy Branch. It strengthened the effect of the Energy Magnetic Attribute, increasing the speed of building machines and the power of using machines. It was another passive ability that increased every level by 3%.

He had practiced the [Energy Training Technique] 34 times in total. Compared to the previous 10 times, he had gained 72 more Energy Points. His Energy Points had not reached Lv5 yet.

He had 380,000 EXP on his interface, which was the result of mass production of high-explosive bullets. He would get 20,000 to 30,000 EXP every day, and money was even more out of the question. He had accumulated 3,600,000 Aquamarine Dollars, which was more than enough for him to move around.

First, I need to fuse the Disguise Blueprint!

Han Xiao invested a few thousand EXP and raised [Basic Programming] to level 3.

Knowledge fusion was not limited to just two knowledges. Every time he fused a basic knowledge, the cost would increase by 5,000 EXP. For example, if he fused the same combination again, it would cost him 40,000 EXP.

Normally, Mechanic class players would only fuse two knowledges. The chances of fusing more than two knowledges were not high.

Han Xiao naturally did not have such concerns. He was very clear about the distribution of these knowledges and could accurately fuse the blueprints he needed.

Fusion successful. Congratulations on developing [Artificial Intelligence Optical Mask]!

Han Xiao exhaled. This was definitely a good thing. The first time it appeared was in Version 3.0. At that time, players had only managed to fuse this blueprint by chance. First, the combination of the four knowledges was very difficult to rely on luck, and it spanned across three branches. Secondly, the four knowledges had to be at his current level. Thirdly, the prerequisite of the skills and attributes required was Intermediate Machinery Affinity, 55 Intelligence, and Lv.3 Basic Programming. Lastly, he had to be a Mechanic.
